# Check A02-10: swapped letters in pinyin

The new build is installed on this Mac (scripts/install.sh, 2026-10-21).

1. Switch to Tatakikun in any app.
2. Type `zhogn`: 中, 重, 种… in the bar (gray), and `zhogn` as typed at the end.
3. Type `zhognguo` → 中国; `nihoa` → 你好; `hne` → 很.
4. Type valid input and check nothing changed: `zhong` → 中 (not gray), `is` → is, `an` → an/安.
